_about: Changes applied on top of the upstream strings in Export/. Run `python tools/patch.py` after editing; output goes to Patched/.

operations._about: Field overrides for operations, by module then operation name. Rule used: no floor under 60%, low-volume items (patterns, xmog) at 70%.

assign._about: Give a group that ships without operations one that already exists in another upstream file.

leave_unassigned._about: Groups kept with no operations on purpose, so TSM never posts, mails or vendors them.
leave_unassigned.z - lockboxes.txt: Rogue: opened with Pick Lock, never sold
